size_rationale: Small because it is a one-line fix in one file, and the prompt names the field (role) whose default in the user model is the place.
prompt: Accounts created through POST /v1/auth/register come back with role 'admin' instead of 'user', and can then use the admin-only user endpoints.

root_cause.detail: The role field defaults to 'admin' instead of 'user', so users created without an explicit role (self-registration) become admins.

fail_to_pass: tests/integration/auth.test.js > Auth routes > POST /v1/auth/register > should return 201 and successfully register user if request data is ok
oracle.cmd: npx jest tests/integration/auth.test.js -t 'should return 201 and successfully register user if request data is ok'
